spec.name: Accordion
spec.description: A stack of sections whose content expands and collapses under a heading, like an FAQ. Use with AccordionItem.

allowsMultipleExpanded.description: Lets several sections be open at once. Otherwise opening one closes the others.

defaultExpandedKeys.description: Sections open at first, by id, when uncontrolled.

onExpandedChange.description: Called with the ids of the open sections.

keyboard: Tab moves between section headings
Enter or Space opens or closes the focused section
requirements: Each heading is a real heading (h3 by default) with a button inside, exposing aria-expanded
The button controls its panel (aria-controls), and the panel is labelled by the button
Collapsed content is removed from the tab order and hidden from screen readers
Expanding respects reduced motion
screenReader: Each section is announced as a heading and a button, collapsed or expanded
Opening a section announces it as expanded; its content follows in reading order
Headings appear in the screen reader's headings list, for quick navigation

use_when: FAQs and long help pages
Settings grouped into sections people rarely need all at once
avoid_when: Content everyone needs: show it
Switching between views of the same thing: use Tabs
anti_patterns: Nesting accordions inside accordions
Putting the only important information in a collapsed section

spec.name: Button
spec.description: Triggers an action or event, such as submitting a form or opening a dialog.

isDisabled.description: Prevents interaction and dims the button.

isLoading.description: Shows a spinner and blocks presses. The button stays focusable, is marked aria-disabled, and the pending state is announced.

children.description: Button label. Icon-only buttons must pass aria-label instead.

onPress.description: Called when the button is pressed by mouse, touch or keyboard.

keyboard: Enter activates
Space activates
requirements: Must have visible text or an aria-label
Focus ring must meet 3:1 contrast against its background
screenReader: Announced as a button with its visible label
An icon-only button (the ⚙ in the playground) announces its aria-label, not the icon
Disabled: announced as unavailable or dimmed
Loading: announced as unavailable, and the busy state is spoken when loading starts

use_when: Performing an action on the current page
Submitting a form
avoid_when: Navigating to another page: use Link
anti_patterns: More than one primary button in the same area
Vague labels like 'Click here'

isLoading.description: Shows a spinner in the field, e.g. while an async search runs.

emptyMessage.description: Shown when nothing matches the input.

isDisabled.description: Prevents interaction and dims the field.

isInvalid.description: Marks the field invalid and shows errorMessage.

isRequired.description: Requires a selection for form submission.

spec.name: DataGrid
spec.description: Accessible, virtualized data grid for large datasets: sorting, filtering, row selection, resizable and pinned columns, row grouping with totals, tree data and expandable detail rows. Columns are TanStack Table column definitions.

label.description: Accessible name of the grid, e.g. 'Orders'.

data.description: Rows to show. Keep the array reference stable between renders.

columns.description: TanStack Table column definitions. Give each column an id or accessorKey.

getRowId.description: Stable id per row. Needed for selection to survive sorting and filtering.

height.description: Height of the scrolling area in px.

virtualized.description: Renders only visible rows. Keeps 100k rows fast.

sortable.description: Lets users sort by clicking or pressing Enter on a header. Shift adds a secondary sort.

selectionMode.description: Adds a checkbox column and Space-to-select.

onSelectionChange.description: Called with the selected row ids.

globalFilter.description: Shows only rows where some cell contains this text (case-insensitive).

resizableColumns.description: Drag a header edge, or press Alt+Left/Right on a header, to resize.

pinnedColumns.description: Column ids kept visible on the left while scrolling sideways.

showColumnFilters.description: Adds a filter row under the header. Set meta.filter on a column to 'text', 'select' or false.

pageSize.description: Rows per page. When set, a pager is shown; when not, all rows scroll (virtualized).

onCellEdit.description: Called when the user saves an edit in a column with meta.editable. Update your data to apply it.

isLoading.description: Marks the grid busy and shows a loading message.

emptyMessage.description: Shown when there are no rows to display.

onRowAction.description: Called on Enter or double-click on a row, e.g. to open details.

onFilteredDataChange.description: Called with the rows that match the search and column filters, in display order, whenever they change. Use it for counts and totals.

groupBy.description: Column ids to group rows by, outermost first. Group rows show the value, a row count, and a total in each column that sets aggregationFn ('sum', 'mean', 'min', 'max', 'count', 'uniqueCount' or a function).

defaultExpanded.description: Start with every group, tree row and detail panel open.

getSubRows.description: Tree data: returns a row's children. Rows with children get an expand toggle and are indented by depth. Search keeps a parent when a child matches.

renderDetail.description: Master-detail: content shown in a panel under a row when it's expanded.

detailHeight.description: Height of each detail panel in px; the panel scrolls if its content is taller.

keyboard: Tab moves into the grid, to the last focused cell; Tab again leaves it
Arrow keys move between cells, including the header row
Home/End move to the first/last cell in the row
Ctrl+Home/Ctrl+End move to the first/last cell in the grid
PageUp/PageDown move by one screen of rows
Enter or Space on a header sorts; with Shift it adds a secondary sort
Alt+Left/Right on a header resizes the column
Space on a row toggles its selection; Ctrl+A selects all (multiple mode)
Enter on a row calls onRowAction
Enter or F2 on an editable cell starts editing; typing a character starts editing with it, including the first key of an IME (Japanese, Chinese, Korean input)
While editing, Enter saves and Escape cancels; focus returns to the cell
Enter or typing on a filter cell moves into its filter; Escape returns to the grid
On a group, tree or detail row, Right arrow in the toggle cell expands it and Left arrow collapses it; Enter on a group row (or on the toggle cell, when it isn't editable) toggles it
Space on a group row selects or clears all its rows (multiple mode)
requirements: On touch screens, tapping the selected editable cell again opens its editor, so the phone keyboard appears
Grid has an accessible name
aria-rowcount and aria-rowindex reflect the full dataset, even when virtualized
Sorted columns expose aria-sort
Selected rows expose aria-selected
Only one cell is in the tab order at a time (roving tabindex)
Filter inputs and editors are labelled with their column name
Pager announces the visible row range
With grouping, tree data or detail rows the role is treegrid; rows expose aria-level and, when they can open, aria-expanded
Group rows show their row count; only columns with an aggregationFn show a total, never the first row's value
The expand toggle is a labelled button (Expand / Collapse) that isn't a separate tab stop
screenReader: Entering the grid announces its name and size (rows and columns)
Moving across announces each column header; moving down announces row numbers from the full dataset (row 50,000 of 100,001), even though rows are virtualized
Sorting with Enter announces the new sort direction on that header
Selected rows are announced as selected
Filter cells: Enter or typing moves into an input announced as Filter <column>
Editing: Enter opens an edit field announced as Edit <column>; after Enter, the saved value is read
The pager's range (Rows 11–20 of 237) is announced after changing page
Group and tree rows announce their level and whether they are expanded or collapsed
With NVDA, table navigation (Ctrl+Alt+Arrow keys) works in browse mode

use_when: Scanning, sorting and acting on many records, like orders, users or logs
avoid_when: A few items with rich layout: use a list or cards
Pure layout: never use a grid for layout
anti_patterns: Buttons in every cell instead of a row action
Horizontal scrolling without pinning the identifying column
Formatting numbers or dates in a custom cell renderer: search and filters won't find the text users see. Use meta.format (e.g. a currency formatter) instead
